messages:
ash: quick ping — PR #4128 fixes a regressing attention kernel for long sequences (seq=4096). Observed ~12% p99 tail in staging. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4128

jon: taking a look now, running perf job. ETA ~30m

ci-bot: perf-run 4128 started (job 1142) — logs: https://ci.redwood/cis/job/1142 :robot_face:

maria: @jon left a comment about the tiling boundary — might affect odd lengths (e.g., 4095)

jon: saw it, adding a small unit test for odd lengths. also seeing a small mem spike in local repro, investigating.

ash: thanks. If perf looks good we want to merge before tomorrow's deploy window (09:00 UTC). Prefer canary (2%) first.

runtime-oncall: noted. If merged, please add canary config: route 2% to this variant and monitor p95/p99 and OOMs.

ci-bot: perf-run 4128 completed — p50 ~same, p99 down 9% in staging, no regressions in CPU/mem graphs. logs: https://ci.redwood/cis/job/1142/console

ash: great. @maria can you LGTM the tiling change?

maria: lgtm, left one nit (non-blocking) about comment wording. :+1:

ash: merging in 15m unless objections. will post a deploy note and the canary route once merged.

jon: no objections — i'll watch the canary and start a repro on some long-seq workloads after merge.

ash: thanks everyone :rocket:
